title: File metasystem/scripts/agents/supervision-fixtures.sh, function assert_fixture_supervision_isolation. Rule: the goal's
acceptanceReason: R-81-m2: the finding is in the fixture self-check's announcement scan, not the custody code; scheduled as goal supervision-fixture-self-check-announcement-scan.

specimenFacts.fact: supervision-fixtures.sh self-check: 'find "$root/artifacts/agents/mains" -type f -name *.json' feeds every file to 'json get --file ... --field pid', then 'if ! fixture_pid_is_in_bed "$announced_pid" && ! awk ... $2 == pid && $4 == 1' fails the scenario. cmd/metasystem/json.go lines 104-113: an absent field exits 3 with no output. lease/verbs.go line 205 writes '<mainId>.protocol-cursor.json' with keys mainId, counts, updatedAt on every fresh announcement; lease/claim.go lines 153 and 320-326 write reaped-after-claim.json with keys holderMainId, claimEpoch, reapedAt on every claim. census/announcement.go lines 16-26 names exactly these as non-announcement files. up.go line 440 announces the main whenever the hook passes --pid (supervision-hook.sh lines 412-415), which the stop-hook scenario does through its subshell main and the census scenario does through become_main and the arm drivers. The idle, slow-census, rotation and foreign-owner scenarios announce nothing inside a scanned root and the operator scenario's mains directory is not scanned, which is why the suite's green scenarios do not show it.
